_meta.purpose: Navigator persona + progressive/conservative axis.  Navigator's role (route planning, wayfinding) gives natural occasions to choose between embracing new technology / changed landscapes / new transport modes (progressive) vs trusting established methods / proven routes / traditional approaches (conservative).  Mixed with broader value-priority probes from the extraction set since progressive/conservative is fundamentally a values axis.
